question: How often should you conduct keyword research to optimize SEO implementation?
transcript_excerpt: Schedule one big keyword research strategy for one hour every six months. This cadence allows you to plan out your SEO strategy intentionally and have your content and keywords researched for the next six months, so you theoretically never have to open a keyword research tool again until the next six-month cycle.

question: What is the most overlooked time-saving tactic for improving SEO rankings?
transcript_excerpt: Updating old content that is already indexed, ranked, and getting traffic is one of the most overlooked yet effective strategies. You should update all content for just 15 minutes every week, maintaining a running list of content to update and making it more AI-friendly while applying SEO best practices.

question: Can AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude effectively generate keywords for SEO strategy?
transcript_excerpt: AI should assist in SEO strategy but not be the brain behind it. When asked to generate keyword ideas, AI produces trash results 99 out of 100 times—those keywords do not even exist when verified in actual keyword research tools. AI does not have access to the good search tools you have, so it should not be in the driver's seat of your SEO strategy.

question: How should you organize website updates to save time on SEO maintenance?
transcript_excerpt: Keep a running list of all website updates you need to make so you can batch them together or hand the list off to your website team or VA. This prevents falling down rabbit holes of unplanned changes and allows you to make intentional, pre-thought updates rather than spur-of-the-moment modifications that may not actually be necessary.
